Welcome! 
This channel is primarily for veterinary surgical education and clinical demonstrations.
I hope these videos help veterinarians provide exceptional surgical care to their patients.

Alex Fox-Alvarez DVM, MS, DACVS-SA
Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon at The Veterinary Surgicenter in Gainesville , FL
Courtesy Faculty at the University of Florida College of Veterinary Medicine
